card.name: Odd punctuation and broken-up words
card.fires_on: Fires on a stray character in the middle of a broken or unusual sequence, such as the dots of an ellipsis, a lone letter in "(n=1)", or the "num" in "innumerable". It also fires on odd accented characters standing in for a dash or space.

modes.label: Ellipsis dots
modes.description: The second or third period of a spaced ellipsis within running prose.
modes.example: others. .<< .>> . . . Do you struggle with teaching

modes.label: Inside split words
modes.description: The middle piece of the word innumerable, split into separate parts.
modes.example: The Romans dotted the countryside with in<<num>>erable military encampments

modes.label: Lone symbols in lists
modes.description: A single letter or comma inside a parenthetical or a numbered list.

card.plain: It lights up on odd bits of punctuation and broken-up words where the text is not following normal spelling.
